title: MDR/XDR as Wikipedia resistance words
dek: Encyclopedia definitions lag WHO's 2021 language. Use tb-dr-definitions for the operative grammar; this card is the public search string.
story: Wikipedia still teaches MDR-TB as resistance to isoniazid plus rifampicin, and XDR as an extra pile of second-line names. That is the public search string. WHO's 2021 definitions shifted XDR/pre-XDR around Group A drugs (FQ, BDQ, LZD).
Simplfy's tb-dr-definitions plate is the operative grammar. This card exists so the encyclopedia words related[] into that plate instead of freezing 2010s slogans.
Neither Wikipedia nor this glossary doses BPaLM. Wikidata's P2176 list is also not Group A.
deep: Pre-XDR as FQ resistance among MDR is a WHO object; Wikipedia may or may not match this year.
RR-TB (rifampin resistance) is the operational NAAT door, sometimes without confirmed INH yet.
Surveillance reports must quote WHO, not the infobox.
tb-who-groups ranks drugs; this card does not.

visual.caption: Public words on top, WHO 2021 grammar in the middle, Simplfy definition plate at the bottom. The lesson is lag.
